text.tspan: Divide splits lists recursively until single-item base cases. Conquer merges sorted pieces back upward.
Guaranteed Theta(n log n) time in all cases; requires Theta(n) temporary memory.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Solid lines show recursive splitting; dashed lines show upward merging of sorted sublists.
